# Goldens TestWasmCommandGoldens expects not to build or run on wasip2/wasm
# (decision 0447 stage 3, 2026-11-02): goldens TestSelfhostWasm runs on
# wasip1/wasm (those of wasm_unsupported.txt are not tried) that a
# wasi:cli/command component cannot run yet. A golden not listed that fails,
# and a listed golden that passes, fail the test. Reason after the name.
# Since 2026-11-03 every golden is tried, those of wasm_unsupported.txt too
# (TCP over wasi:sockets, step R1); the network ones wait for step R2.
cmd_inherit # XO1515: no processes in a WASI 0.2 world (proc.exec)
fs_atomic # WASI has no file modes or locks: write_atomic's mode
fs_cwd_path # no working directory under WASI
fs_dir_errors # WASI has no file modes or locks
fs_files # WASI has no file modes or locks
fs_mkdir_mode # WASI has no file modes or locks: create_dir_all_mode
fs_ops_edges # WASI has no times before 1970
handle_drop_leak # XO1515: no processes in a WASI 0.2 world (proc.spawn)
host_usage # XO1515: no processes in a WASI 0.2 world (proc.run)
lock_drop_relock # WASI has no file modes or locks
net_only # XO1515: no processes in a WASI 0.2 world (proc.run)
proc_child_usage # XO1515: no processes in a WASI 0.2 world (proc.spawn)
proc_children_load # XO1515: no processes in a WASI 0.2 world (proc.exec)
proc_cmd # XO1515: no processes in a WASI 0.2 world (proc.run)
rt_addrs # the wasm backend does not support the call `rt.fn_addr`
signal_notify # XO1515: no processes in a WASI 0.2 world (proc.run)
sys_c # the platform call `getpid` of c on another OS
term_stdio # the wasm backend does not support the call `rt.call_c2` (obj.heap_word)
unix_kill # XO1515: no processes in a WASI 0.2 world (proc.spawn)
use_c_add # use c: no C calls on wasm
use_c_enum # use c: no C calls on wasm
user_caps # XO1515: no processes in a WASI 0.2 world (proc.run)
